E20 measured three designs dead before proposing a fourth: (1) a CI guard on git commit recency — killed, because 5 of the 7 WORKING lanes had never committed anything, so it would red five healthy lanes; (2) a CI guard on the offline half — killed, because it fails a contributor's PR over the MANAGER's behaviour, the one actor who cannot fix it; (3) a Routine firing a FRESH session — built, fired once, DISABLED the same minute, because the fired session had no repo checkout (sources: []) and no Claude Code Remote MCP tools, so it could neither read lane_reconcile.py nor call list_sessions. A watcher that cannot reach its subject and reports nothing is the exact defect class this row is about. [!] THE FOURTH DESIGN, AND WHY IT IS DIFFERENT: a PERSISTENT supervisor session created with the repo as a source, woken by a cron Routine bound to it via persistent_session_id. A persistent-session Routine delivers into a session that already HAS a checkout and its own tool grants, which is precisely what the fresh-session firing lacked. ⚠️ THIS IS A HYPOTHESIS UNTIL THE LANE MEASURES IT — E20's three capability checks (a repo checkout present, list_sessions callable, the served model) must be run against the woken supervisor and REPORTED, and if any is absent the design is killed like the other three rather than shipped hopeful. A fallback that is honest beats a watchdog that reports nothing. [!] WHAT IT MAY AND MAY NOT DO, because an autonomous archiver is a way to destroy work: archive only sessions whose bucket is COMPLETED or FAILED AND which are idle beyond a stated threshold AND which hold no open PR — never WORKING, never BLOCKED. A BLOCKED lane is NOT archived: only a human can clear a permission prompt, so the supervisor's job there is to RAISE it fast, and the surface it raises on must be one the operator already reads — the checklist rendered at GET /api/bot/work/checklist — not a chat message and not a new register. Archiving is reversible (unarchive_session); deleting is not, and this row authorises no deletion. resolution_criteria: a supervisor session and its Routine exist; a firing has been OBSERVED to read the repo and call list_sessions (or the design is recorded dead with the reading that killed it); a BLOCKED or over-idle lane appears on the operator's Workflow page without a manager having run anything. severity: high — this is the single largest measured waste in the account and it recurs weekly.
